activationExecutionAudit.purpose: Debug execution tensor quantization audit, not a speed test

staticMetadataCpuAblation.scope: PC numeric ablation only, not ARM speed; same smoothed W4 weights with activation metadata removed

format.kv4: MNN attention_mode=14: FlashAttention plus TQ4 K/V
format.a4Attempt: Official SmoothQuant implementation called with experimental act_bit=4, 20 local calibration texts; 308 static descriptors with min=-7/max=7/type=DT_INT8
format.runtimeAudit: Callback sees four-bit range metadata and FloatToInt8/Convolution DT_INT8 wrappers; logical tensor type remains float32. This does not prove packed INT4 arithmetic.

parallelism.prefill: One multi-token forward, GEMM tiling and token/output parallelism; causal attention can process query blocks in parallel.
parallelism.decode: One new token per dependent step, GEMV or M=1 GEMM plus head/context parallelism inside a step; future autoregressive steps cannot run independently.
parallelism.mnnGraphSelection: Llm::forwardRaw selects prefill module key 100 and decode sequence-length key 1; both share RuntimeManager and configured thread_num.
parallelism.setConfigAfterLoadWarning: Changing thread_num JSON after load does not reconstruct the loaded runtime; not tested as a valid stage thread switch.
parallelism.sme2: No SME2 feature reported by this phone; do not attribute results to SME2-specific mixed-core hints.

conclusions: Standard W4/g64 route works; 6 threads observed about 25-28 decode tokens/s, 512-token prefill about 1.40-1.58s across the paired baseline runs.
KV4 reduces retained KV storage but was slower than KV16 at this context and degraded reference-continuation agreement; peak RSS includes loading and was not lower in every short test.
A4-range plus KV4 is not a deployable result: Low produced finite but unusable language logits, High produced non-finite logits. A8 static control also failed quality.

Exact smoothed W4 weights with activation metadata removed recover language agreement, localizing a failure to the current static activation graph/execution combination rather than proving A4 inherently impossible.

One original synthetic 512-token context and 128 fixed continuation predictions, ignoring EOS for fixed-length timing. Agreement/NLL are regression indicators, not general language quality or perplexity benchmarks.
No App replacement, no packed W4A4KV4 speed claim, no QuaRot whole-model checkpoint deployment. QuaRot-style projection tests are separate.
